verdicts.title: An overview of generalised Kac-Moody algebras on compact real manifolds
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: A generalised notion of Kac-Moody algebra is defined using smooth maps from a compact real manifold $\mathcal{M}$ to a finite-dimensional Lie group, by means of complete orthonormal bases for a Hermitian inner product on the manifold and a Fourier expansion.
